The '''Planetary Civic Authority''' was the authority which regulated [[Mayor/Legends|mayoral]] [[Politics/Legends|elections]] and other civic regulations pertaining to [[City/Legends|outposts, villages, townships, cities, and metropolises]] on multiple [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and [[Moon/Legends|moons]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
